title: China To The Rescue
summary: Will Chinese Oil Imports Recover After The Iran War? For several decades, there has been one reliable growth engine for oil demand in the world: China. China's massive growth in oil demand in the early 2000s was the primary driver of the tanker super cycle that lasted from roughly 2001 to 2009.
